commands.command: index=wineventlog EventCode=4625 Logon_Type=3 | bucket _time span=10m | stats dc(Account_Name) as unique_users count by src_ip _time | where unique_users > 5 | sort -unique_users

commands.description: Kerberos pre-auth failures across many accounts (Event 4771).
commands.command: index=wineventlog EventCode=4771 Failure_Code=0x18 | bucket _time span=5m | stats dc(Account_Name) as unique_users by src_ip _time | where unique_users > 5

commands.command: index=wineventlog EventCode=4625 | stats count dc(Account_Name) as targets by src_ip | where targets > 10 | sort -targets

AD - Password Spraying.tuning: Tune threshold by baselining unique_users per src_ip per 10m in your environment. Exclude service accounts and known legitimate tools (health checks). Add whitelist for known scanner IPs.

commands.description: Explicit credential logon — RunAs, OverPtH, or scheduled task with alternate creds (Event 4648).
commands.command: index=wineventlog EventCode=4648 NOT Account_Name IN ("SYSTEM","LOCAL SERVICE","NETWORK SERVICE","DWM-*","UMFD-*") | stats count by Account_Name Target_Account_Name Workstation_Name src_ip | sort -count

commands.description: Special privileges assigned at logon — SeDebugPrivilege, SeTcbPrivilege (Event 4672).
commands.command: index=wineventlog EventCode=4672 (Privilege_List="*SeDebugPrivilege*" OR Privilege_List="*SeTcbPrivilege*" OR Privilege_List="*SeImpersonatePrivilege*" OR Privilege_List="*SeTakeOwnershipPrivilege*") NOT Account_Name IN ("SYSTEM","LOCAL SERVICE","NETWORK SERVICE") | stats count by Account_Name Privilege_List host | sort -count

commands.description: Sensitive privilege use — SeDebugPrivilege, SeBackupPrivilege (Event 4673).
commands.command: index=wineventlog EventCode=4673 (Privilege_List="*SeDebugPrivilege*" OR Privilege_List="*SeBackupPrivilege*" OR Privilege_List="*SeRestorePrivilege*") NOT Account_Name IN ("SYSTEM","LOCAL SERVICE") | stats count by Account_Name Privilege_List host Process_Name | sort -count

commands.description: User account deleted — attacker covering tracks post-compromise (Event 4726).
commands.command: index=wineventlog EventCode=4726 | stats count by Account_Name Target_Account_Name host | sort -count

commands.description: User account changed — delegation enabled, password not required flag set (Event 4738).
commands.command: index=wineventlog EventCode=4738 (Changed_Attributes="*DONT_REQ_PREAUTH*" OR Changed_Attributes="*TRUSTED_FOR_DELEGATION*" OR Changed_Attributes="*PASSWORD_NOT_REQUIRED*" OR Changed_Attributes="*PASSWD_NOTREQD*") | stats count by Account_Name Target_Account_Name Changed_Attributes | sort -count

commands.description: Service installed via Security log — higher fidelity than System 7045 for actor attribution (Event 4697).
commands.command: index=wineventlog EventCode=4697 NOT Service_File_Name IN ("*System32*","*SysWOW64*","*Program Files*","*MsMpEng*") | stats count by Account_Name Service_Name Service_File_Name host | sort -count

commands.description: Scheduled task modified — attacker updating persistence task payload (Event 4702).
commands.command: index=wineventlog EventCode=4702 NOT Account_Name IN ("SYSTEM","LOCAL SERVICE") | stats count by Account_Name Task_Name host | sort -count

commands.description: RDP session reconnect — potential session hijack or stolen token reuse (Event 4778).
commands.command: index=wineventlog EventCode=4778 | stats count by Account_Name Workstation_Name Client_Address host | sort -count

commands.description: WFP inbound connection allowed to non-standard process — C2 bind or reverse shell (Event 5156).
commands.command: index=wineventlog EventCode=5156 Direction="%%14593" NOT Application_Name IN ("*svchost*","*lsass*","*System*","*MsMpEng*","*SearchIndexer*") | stats count by Application_Name dest_port src_ip host | sort -count

commands.description: System reboot detected — verify attack survived reboot (Event 6005 = svc start, 6006 = svc stop).
commands.command: index=wineventlog EventCode IN (6005, 6006) | table _time host EventCode Message | sort -_time

WIN - MFA & Identity Bypass.description: Detect MFA bypass, legacy auth, and identity-based evasion on Windows endpoints and Azure-connected environments.

commands.description: Legacy protocol authentication bypassing MFA (BasicAuth).
commands.command: index=azure sourcetype=azure:aad:signinlogs ClientAppUsed IN ("Exchange ActiveSync","SMTP","POP3","IMAP4","MAPI over HTTP") ResultType=0 | stats count by UserPrincipalName IPAddress ClientAppUsed | sort -count

commands.description: Successful sign-in after multiple MFA failures — AiTM pattern.
commands.command: index=azure sourcetype=azure:aad:signinlogs | eval auth_req=mvindex('AuthenticationRequirement',0) | eval result=mvindex('ResultType',0) | stats list(result) as results by UserPrincipalName IPAddress | where results like "%0x%0%"

commands.description: New device registration after phishing event.
commands.command: index=azure sourcetype=azure:audit operationName="Register device" | stats count by initiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName targetResources{}.id | sort -count

WIN - RBCD & Kerberos Delegation Detecti.description: Detect Resource-Based Constrained Delegation (RBCD) setup and S4U2Proxy abuse via Event 5136 attribute modification and Kerberos ticket patterns.

commands.description: Detect msDS-AllowedToActOnBehalfOfOtherIdentity write via Event 5136
commands.command:
index=wineventlog EventCode=5136
| search AttributeLDAPDisplayName="msDS-AllowedToActOnBehalfOfOtherIdentity"
| table _time, SubjectUserName, ObjectDN, OperationType
| sort -_time

commands.description: Detect machine account creation followed by RBCD attribute write (correlated)
commands.command:
index=wineventlog (EventCode=4741 OR EventCode=5136)
| eval event_type=if(EventCode=4741,"MachineCreated","RBCDWrite")
| stats values(event_type) as events by SubjectUserName
| where mvcount(events)>1

commands.description: Detect S4U2Self/S4U2Proxy Kerberos tickets — event 4769 with suspicious SPN
commands.command:
index=wineventlog EventCode=4769
| where TicketOptions="0x20000" AND NOT match(ServiceName, "\$")
| stats count by AccountName, ServiceName, IpAddress
| where count>3
| sort -count

commands.description: Detect RBCD + lateral movement chain: machine account creation → RBCD write → TGS request
commands.command:
index=wineventlog EventCode IN (4741, 5136, 4769)
| eval stage=case(EventCode==4741,"1-MachineCreated",EventCode==5136,"2-RBCDWrite",EventCode==4769,"3-TGSRequest")
| transaction SubjectUserName maxspan=1h
| where mvcount(stage)>=2
| table _time, SubjectUserName, stage

WIN - RBCD & Kerberos Delegation Detecti.tuning: Whitelist legitimate Kerberos service accounts and scheduled tasks. Alert on RC4/DES downgrade requests for high-privilege SPNs. Cross-reference with Splunk identity logs.

LNX - Cloud IMDS & PwnKit Detection.description: Detect cloud IMDS credential theft and CVE-2021-4034 (PwnKit) pkexec exploitation on Linux endpoints.

commands.description: Detect IMDS access from unexpected processes (not cloud agent or SDK)
commands.command:
index=endpoint sourcetype=syslog
| search dest_ip="169.254.169.254" AND NOT process IN ("python3","python","aws","azure-metadata","waagent","google_metadata")
| table _time, host, process, user, dest_ip, uri_path
| sort -_time

commands.description: Detect pkexec spawning unexpected child process (PwnKit CVE-2021-4034 indicator)
commands.command:
index=endpoint sourcetype=syslog
| search process_name="pkexec"
| where NOT match(process_args, "--user|--help|--version")
| table _time, host, user, process_name, process_args, parent_process
| sort -_time

commands.description: Detect privilege escalation via polkit — pkexec spawned as root from non-root user
commands.command:
index=endpoint
| search process_name="pkexec" effective_uid=0
| where NOT match(parent_process, "gnome|kde|xfce|dbus-daemon")
| table _time, host, user, effective_uid, process_args, parent_process

commands.description: Detect IMDS token requests for sensitive metadata paths
commands.command:
index=proxy OR index=network dest_ip="169.254.169.254"
| search uri_path IN ("/latest/meta-data/iam/security-credentials/*","/metadata/identity/oauth2/token","/computeMetadata/v1/instance/service-accounts/default/token")
| table _time, src_ip, host, uri_path, bytes_out
| sort -_time

AI - LLM & AI Service Abuse Detection.description: Detect LLM API key exposure, unusual traffic to AI service endpoints, and data exfiltration via generative AI APIs.

commands.description: Detect process executing with LLM API key in command line
commands.command:
index=endpoint sourcetype=xmlwineventlog EventCode=4688
| where match(CommandLine, "sk-[a-zA-Z0-9]{48}|sk-ant-|OPENAI_API_KEY|ANTHROPIC_API_KEY")
| table _time, ComputerName, SubjectUserName, CommandLine
| sort -_time

commands.description: Detect outbound connections to AI API endpoints (proxy/firewall logs)
commands.command:
index=network OR index=proxy
| search dest_host IN ("api.openai.com","api.anthropic.com","generativelanguage.googleapis.com","*.openai.azure.com")
| stats sum(bytes_out) as total_out, count as requests by src_ip, dest_host, user
| where total_out > 500000
| sort -total_out

commands.description: Detect bulk data upload to AI service (data exfiltration pattern — large POST bodies)
commands.command:
index=proxy dest_host IN ("api.openai.com","api.anthropic.com")
| search http_method=POST bytes_out>50000
| table _time, src_ip, user, dest_host, uri_path, bytes_out
| sort -bytes_out

commands.description: Detect Azure Cognitive Services key listing operation (CloudTrail/AzureActivity equivalent)
commands.command:
index=azure_activity OperationName="Microsoft.CognitiveServices/accounts/listKeys/action"
| table _time, Caller, ResourceGroup, OperationName, ResultType
| sort -_time

WIN - BEC & Email Forwarding Detection.description: Detect Business Email Compromise (BEC) via M365 inbox rule creation, email forwarding to external addresses, and OAuth application consent grants.

commands.description: Detect inbox forwarding rule to external email address (BEC persistence)
commands.command:
index=o365 Operation="New-InboxRule"
| eval params=iff(isnotnull(Parameters),Parameters,"")
| where match(params, "ForwardTo.*@") OR match(params, "DeleteMessage.*True")
| table _time, UserId, ClientIP, params
| sort -_time

commands.description: Detect M365 login from new country/IP followed by inbox rule creation within 1 hour
commands.command:
index=o365 (Operation="UserLoggedIn" OR Operation="New-InboxRule")
| bucket _time span=1h
| stats dc(ClientIP) as ip_count, values(Operation) as ops, values(ClientIP) as ips by UserId, _time
| where mvcount(ops)>1 AND ip_count>1

commands.description: Detect OAuth application granted Mail.ReadWrite or Mail.Send scope (BEC app consent)
commands.command:
index=azure_ad Operation="Consent to application"
| where match(ModifiedProperties, "Mail.ReadWrite|Mail.Send|MailboxSettings.ReadWrite")
| table _time, InitiatedBy, TargetResources{}.displayName, ModifiedProperties
| sort -_time

commands.description: Detect anomalous outbound email volume from single account (mass phishing/BEC pivot)
commands.command:
index=o365 Operation="Send"
| stats count as sent by UserId, ClientIP
| where sent > 100
| sort -sent
